summary: This dataset describes a two-step surgical procedure for treating stable follicular vitiligo, involving the removal of leukotrichia and subsequent hair transplantation. The procedure involves shaving and incising the vitiligo lesion, scraping back and forth with a fenestrated cup curette to remove subcutaneous tissue, and then transplanting hair grafts into the recipient site using the FUE technique. The study assesses patient satisfaction with the cosmetic results after surgery using a visual analogue scale, and evaluates the effectiveness of the procedure through follow-up imaging with a camera and dermatoscope.
